The '''Dalonbian sector''' in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] contained the [[Belkadan system/Legends|Belkadan]] and [[Helska system/Legends|Helska systems]]. The sector was adjacent to the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi]], [[Chopani sector/Legends|Chopani]], [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz]], [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar]], and [[Spinward sector/Legends|Spinward sectors]].

==History==
By the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], the planets [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]] and [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] had governments which were secretly controlled by a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|secret Sith Empire]]. These governments turned on the Republic fleet in the Tingel Arm at the beginning of the war.

Millennia later, it was the located near to [[Vector Prime]], the coordinates at which the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] entered [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during their incursions and [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]]. By [[137 ABY]], the Coreward part of this sector was a part of [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[The Essential Atlas]]'s appendix incorrectly places Artorias to the L-2 coordinates, while the maps of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] place the world to the K-3 grid coordinates. The first version of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Essential Atlas Online Companion'']] still used the wrong coordinates that placed Artorias in the Dalonbian sector, but the later .pdf version corrected this and placed the planet in the [[Myto sector/Legends|Myto sector]].
